name: Cito C1922

origin.basis: CST is the Cheng Shin (正新) brand of Taiwan's Cheng Shin Rubber; China listings give the brand as CST/正新.

manufacturing.basis: The listings do not state the factory; Cheng Shin also makes bicycle tires at a mainland plant.

positioning: Lightweight folding race clincher with a 170 TPI casing (listing), sold at budget prices in China.
weight_basis: The listing gives 185 g without stating the size.

community.summary: Lighter, softer and more comfortable than the Continental GSR but noisier, with small tread cuts early on.

availability.note: Widely sold by mainland Taobao and Tmall shops; no official CST store was found, and CST's international site no longer showed model pages on 2026-11-01.

price_observations.market: 云天 优质正品 (Taobao shop)
price_observations.conditions: Taobao/Tmall shop list price on 2026-11-01; shipping within mainland China. The listing does not say whether an option is one tire or a pair.

caveats: Only 23 and 25 mm were found; it is outside the 28 mm-plus trend.
Soft tread cuts easily, according to owners.
